# Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root before any task. It has the project's hard rules, how to run, test and deploy, and the lessons we follow when building the AI agents.

The rules that matter most:

- No real football data, names or logos in the repo or the demo. Real StatsBomb data stays in `data/real/` on your machine (DATA_POLICY.md).
- No keys or secrets in git. They go in `.env`.
- Run the backend and frontend checks in AGENTS.md before every commit, and work on a branch with a PR, never on `main`.
